fact: The African Telecommunications Union's status of signatures and ratifications as at 22.01.2026 lists Libya as having signed and ratified the PATU conventions of Addis Ababa (1977), Kinshasa (1982) and Arusha (1986) and as having acceded to the ATU Constitution and Convention (Cape Town 1999, revised Harare 2014).
title: Annex 1: Status on signing/ratifications/accessions of ATU as at 22.01.2026
